label: Product Requirements
description: Define user-facing behavior, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what a product/feature should do.

label: Workflow Review
description: Review user workflows, ergonomics, states, or product flows.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a user flow makes sense.

label: Product Release Notes
description: Define user-facing release messaging and notable behavior changes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what should be communicated in a release from a product perspective.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a raw technical changelog only.

label: Product Spec Writing
description: Write product specs with behavior, states, and constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a feature spec.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for implementation code only.

label: User Story Writing
description: Write user stories, scenarios, and user value statements.

label: Product Acceptance
description: Define acceptance criteria from a product perspective.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what behavior must be accepted.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for technical test implementation.

label: PRD Writing
description: Write product requirements documents and decision context.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for marketing launch copy only.

label: Feature Prioritization
description: Prioritize product features by value, cost, risk, and evidence.

classifier.useWhen: User asks which features to build first.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for code-level sequencing only.

label: Feedback Synthesis
description: Synthesize user feedback, themes, pain points, and opportunities.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for scientific evidence review.

label: Launch Readiness
description: Assess product readiness, blockers, messaging, and rollout risk.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a feature is ready to launch.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to execute deployment steps.
